notes.title: A Year of Optimization : Major Overhaul!
notes.content:
Motherbored brings a sweeping series of enhancements, encompassing major feature additions, core gameplay adjustments, and targeted performance optimizations. Every change, large or small, has been implemented to create a more fluid and enjoyable experience.

[h1]Gameplay Overhaul:[/h1][list]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924119/9458563cd1f4a8ed4d22df40202c70e1fc0a8e50.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924119/bd44210dd3d269f3f07a970fd9bd27caef848cd2.png[/img][/url]

[*] Revamped Progression: "Experience a new leveling system, key system, and comprehensive progression/completion tracking."

[*] Challenging Encounters: "Test your skills against epic boss battles and unlockable area/weapon/portal content."

[*] Improved Combat & Movement: "Benefit from rebalanced ranged/melee weapons, optimized portal travel, and a new swimming system."

[*] Enhanced World Interactions: "Engage with the world through new interactions, a dynamic loot spawning system, and an in-world shop."

[*] Enhanced enemy AI: "Npc's and  enemies have improved AI, and better defenses."
[/list]

[h1]User Interface Enhancements:[/h1][list]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924119/721d72bbe47bb940d8edd461d353c65b44e2418e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924119/9720a934ff04dbd61bad56369ea524fd9779e6d9.png[/img][/url]

[*] Improved Navigation & Information: "Navigate with ease using the new minimap, ability cost guide, and in-game notifications."

[*] Enhanced Clarity: "Receive helpful triggerable hints and sequence introductions to new areas."

[*] Optimized HUD & Resource Icons: "Enjoy a cleaner, more informative interface complete with a revmaped main menu, and in game menu."

[*] Performance Optimizations:

[*] Significant Performance Gains: "Experience smoother gameplay with mesh, code, texture, and material optimizations."

[*] Reduced File Size & Improved Stability: "Enjoy faster load times and a more stable experience, with fixes for long-session slowdowns and various glitches."

[*] Visual Fidelity Improvements: "Fixed water system visuals and particle system issues."

[*] Character Optimizations: Optimized main player model's rig along with new animations and systems.

[*] Smoother collisions: Aside from fixing collision details, ai naviagtion has been revamped with better movement and sensing.
[/list]

[h1]Content Additions:[/h1][list]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924119/99bf4ffea94ce74fb9862c7d806036282dccb0a3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924119/4c2fc275aaf646b5be1c345e5adc1e06f24fc331.png[/img][/url]

[*] New Enemies & Passive NPCs: "Encounter new threats and friendly characters throughout the world."

[*] Expanded Loot & Resources: "Discover a wider variety of valuable items and resources."

[*] Endgame Structure & New Areas: "Explore a revamped endgame and uncover brand-new zones."

[*] Cosmetic Customization: "Express yourself with new helmets and a comprehensive color configuration system."

[*] New Revamped Companions: "Discover new companions with revamped abilities to help you on your journey."

[*] New Game Modes: "Fresh new challenges with exciting new ways to play."

[*] Enhanced Visuals: "Enjoy improved particle systems, updated areas, and new music tracks."

[*] Documents Tracking (In Development): "A new document tracking system. (Follow the story - Coming Soon)."
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.3
notes.content:
[h1][b]Patch Fixes:[/b][/h1]

[h2]AI Navigation:[/h2]
Fixed an issue where spawned enemies would stand still in the far back part of the open world.

[h2]Processor Chips Reset:[/h2]
Fixed an issue where processor chips would reset activation when player died and players would have to locate new floppy discs, they will now be active even after death but will only reset if the game is reset.

[h2]Bomb Radius:[/h2]
The explosion capsule radius of thrown bombs has been increased, damage has also been increased, allowing multiple chips and enemies to be destroyed at once.

[h1][b]Additional Items:[/b][/h1]

[h2]Weapon Variations:[/h2]
Melee weapon exchange pickups have been added throughout the world with each zone having its own-colored versions of all weapons, you will encounter them much more frequently now.

Rare weapons are still in the same location and have been duplicated to other areas, every original assigned weapon is now found twice per each zone, all other melee pickups are singles and in static locations.

[h2]Version Footer:[/h2]
A footer with the current version of the game has been added to the main menu.

notes.title: Update 0.2
notes.content:
[h2][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h2]

[h3]Timed Bit Collection:[/h3]

Fixed an issue where bits would not disappear after being collected during timed events.

[h3]Melee Animation Delay: [/h3]

Addressed a delay in melee animations to ensure smoother combat interactions.

[h3]Chest Opening Glitch: [/h3]

Resolved a glitch where opening one rar chest would inadvertently open another.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924119/be9a24eee9308e14ef3b510c34b5bdce7c2054d2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924119/44f66a014dbce7186325a66ade39c36b81d81125.png[/img][/url]

[h2][b]Performance Enhancements:[/b][/h2]

[h3]Memory Optimization: [/h3]

Reduced the memory cost for chest spawn locations and tick. 

Instanced clusters of actors together for faster rendering.

Removed unnecessary particles that were active at runtime, replaced with trigger to activate and deactivate accordingly. 

Pickups have been reduced in memory and size to improve overall game performance.
